verses.1: And Eiyob gathered together his men and said:
verses.2: Who will give me the strength to endure as the ancient days, in those times when the Lord was still among us?
verses.3: In the darkness, I stand here, with my head held high, as if I were in the light. I go forward, in the darkness.
verses.4: When I was in those days of humiliation, under the judgment of God, in my tent.
verses.5: While I stood there, my friends were around me.
verses.6: In my journey, I walked through heat and suffering. The flames of fire surrounded me.
verses.7: As I stepped out of the gate at Alieh-Karet, my seat was already ready.
verses.8: Young men saw me, they wept. They stood up in fear.
verses.9: The shepherds stopped in their tracks and put their hands to their mouths.
verses.10: The voices of the judges were heard, and they waited for their decision.
verses.11: For she heard my voice and came to me; and she saw me with her eyes and testified for me.
verses.12: For the poor man is pitiful and weak, and he has no one to help him.
verses.13: May the blessing of Oved be upon me; may his heart be filled with joy.
verses.14: Justice has shaved me, and it has shaved me like a covering; it’s like a veil from judgment.
verses.15: My eyes were like those of a hunter, and my feet were like those of a runner.
verses.16: I am an ancestor of those who are not my ancestors, and I know nothing about them.
verses.17: And I will cast them out from their hiding places, and from their nests.
verses.18: And he said to his servants, “Let us go and spend the days in a place where there is plenty of food and water.”
verses.19: My roots are open, like the sea and the rain during the harvest.
verses.20: A new honor has been given to me; I hold it in my hand as a weapon.
verses.21: Let them hear, and they will begin to do as I command.
verses.22: After my words, they will not be changed; they will remain unchanged.
verses.23: And they became like thorns to me; their mouths were wide open in fear.
verses.24: I will mock them; they will not believe. And my face will never be hidden from them.
verses.25: I will choose their path, and I will sit on the throne, just like a king in Baghdad. As for those who are weak, they will be defeated.
